name: Pitch
description: Pitch sections: a brand-composed frame (header, main, footer) every section wears, mechanical parts a main is built from (ranked panels, key-value tables, bullets, stats, columns), and the mains themselves. The brand decides the shell, what each rank looks like, the bullet marker and the takeaway band from documented parts; the agent decides content, rank and arrangement.
whenToUse: A proposal, pitch or recommendation deck rendered as pages: one message per section, evidence ranked, one takeaway. Adopt Pitch; the brand's frame and rank styles live in pitch-composition.tsx (see COMPOSING.md) and the parts are never edited. Mains: Fees. NOT for marketing pages, documentation or anything without an argument to land.
